scope: Native C bug-fix adoption, reproducible execution/measurement, baseline statistics and failure analysis; no new gameplay strategies

integration_policy.authority: Owner instruction 2026-11-06: merge, measure impact and keep going
integration_policy.per_pr: Agent evidence review, normal PR merge and required green checks
integration_policy.external_review: At an accumulated change/evidence milestone; not a per-PR prerequisite

priority_policy: Bugs first, carried or not; verified carries/concrete defect investigations pre-empt discretionary death-analysis work
original_c_discovery_flow: Evidence/duplicate/ownership check -> neo-angband-tracker issue and source fix -> separate consumer adoption/measurement
delivery: Our Angband build with integrated native Borg; official game base tracked through verified integrations

official_tracking.cadence: Each active integration cycle and before importing/delivering game changes

rust_stage2: Canonical tracker -> verified C consumer -> separately owned borg-rs parity target or individual Rust fix carries; pristine parity baseline retained; not integrated here yet

death_records.required: Actual version/build and native evidence, assessment/diagnosis/actions; no repeat inflation
death_records.feedback_threads: Per-case linked GitHub investigation; owner comments -> evidence triage -> linked action -> findings reply/assessment/aggregate
death_records.comment_check_cadence: Each active session start and stop: new/edited comments on per-case investigations and linked open action issues; receipt/follow-up on checkpoint1; not unattended background processing

donor_review.scope: Bounded public C source inventory plus standing semantic review; bugs first; no automatic imports or Rust polling
